title: How to Properly Recycle E-Waste
steps: Do not throw electronic devices in household trash.
Collect devices like phones, chargers, computers, and old TVs separately.
Remove personal data from devices before disposal.
Take e-waste to certified recycling centers to safely recover valuable materials.
Spread awareness in your community about the importance of proper e-waste disposal.
precautions: Do not dismantle electronic devices unless you know proper handling.
Keep e-waste away from children and pets.
Avoid burning e-waste as it releases toxic fumes.
Separate hazardous components like batteries before disposal.
Handle broken electronics carefully to avoid cuts or chemical exposure.
